items.q: According to Brønsted–Lowry, an acid is a:
items.explain: A Brønsted–Lowry acid donates a proton (H⁺).

items.q: In the reaction HCl + H₂O → H₃O⁺ + Cl⁻, water acts as a:
items.qAf: In die reaksie HCl + H₂O → H₃O⁺ + Cl⁻ tree water op as ’n:
items.explain: Water accepts a proton, so it acts as a base.
items.explainAf: Water aanvaar ’n proton, dus tree dit op as ’n basis.

items.q: Which pair is a conjugate acid–base pair?
options: H₂O and OH⁻ are the same
H₃O⁺ and H₂O are not related
optionsAf: H₃O⁺ en H₂O is nie verwant nie
items.explain: HCl donates H⁺ to become Cl⁻, so they differ by one proton.
items.explainAf: HCl skenk H⁺ om Cl⁻ te word, dus verskil hulle met een proton.

items.q: A solution has [H⁺] = 1 × 10⁻³ mol·dm⁻³. What is its pH?
items.qAf: ’n Oplossing het [H⁺] = 1 × 10⁻³ mol·dm⁻³. Wat is die pH?

items.q: A solution has pH 11. What is [OH⁻]? (pOH = 14 − pH)
items.qAf: ’n Oplossing het pH 11. Wat is [OH⁻]? (pOH = 14 − pH)

items.q: Diluting an acid with water makes its pH:
items.qAf: Om ’n suur met water te verdun, maak die pH:
items.explain: Dilution lowers [H⁺], so the pH rises and moves closer to 7.
items.explainAf: Verdunning verlaag [H⁺], so styg die pH en beweeg nader aan 7.

items.q: A substance that donates protons (H⁺ ions), according to Lowry–Brønsted.
items.qAf: ’n Stof wat protone (H⁺-ione) skenk, volgens Lowry-Brønsted.

items.q: A substance that can act as either an acid or a base, such as water.
items.qAf: ’n Stof wat as ’n suur of ’n basis kan optree, soos water.

items.q: An acid that ionises completely in water.
items.qAf: ’n Suur wat volledig in water ioniseer.

items.q: The ion that makes a solution acidic, H₃O⁺.
items.qAf: Die ioon wat ’n oplossing suur maak, H₃O⁺.

items.text: When HCl donates a proton to water, Cl⁻ is its conjugate [[]] and H₃O⁺ is the conjugate [[]] of water.
items.textAf: Wanneer HCl ’n proton aan water skenk, is Cl⁻ sy gekonjugeerde [[]] en H₃O⁺ die gekonjugeerde [[]] van water.

items.q: Ethanoic (acetic) acid is a weak acid.
items.explain: True. It ionises only partly in water.
items.explainAf: Waar. Dit ioniseer net gedeeltelik in water.

items.q: A concentrated acid is always a strong acid.
items.qAf: ’n Gekonsentreerde suur is altyd ’n sterk suur.
items.explain: False. Concentration is the amount per volume; strength is how completely it ionises.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Konsentrasie is die hoeveelheid per volume; sterkte is hoe volledig dit ioniseer.

items.q: Match each acid in column A with its conjugate base in column B.
items.qAf: Pas elke suur in kolom A by sy gekonjugeerde basis in kolom B.
